purpose: Test a portable structural template for Pressure without forcing Pressure into games that lack escalating commitment.

commitment_exposure.basis: label-free public pressure exposure is positive and discriminant in both frozen policy families

response_constriction.basis: predicted opponent fold probability is a family-invariant Pressure observable, consistent with constrained opponent response

strategic_consequence.basis: pressure exposure explains a substantial Pressure-linked surprisal suppression in both families; the stronger Chaos-margin claim remains only partial

commitment_exposure.basis: the prespecified public commitment/escalation score responds strongly to assigned Pressure in both families

response_constriction.basis: the frozen Liar’s Dice protocol does not separately measure whether escalating claims constrict an opponent response set

strategic_consequence.basis: Pressure commitment signal beats shuffled-label expectation in both families, although Family B fails discriminant recovery because Chaos also drives commitment

commitment_exposure.basis: simultaneous fixed-cost RPS has no escalating commitment channel; the frozen Pressure candidate is exactly zero across all policies

response_constriction.basis: each RPS round always leaves the opponent the same three actions; no escalating action narrows the legal response set

strategic_consequence.basis: without a Pressure channel there is no Pressure-specific strategic consequence to test

conclusion.basis: Escalating public commitment transfers cleanly between Poker and Liar’s Dice and is correctly absent in RPS. Opponent-response constriction is strongly supported in Poker but not yet separately tested in Liar’s Dice, so the full Pressure mechanism is not yet cross-game confirmed.

guardrails: No source policy, threshold, or frozen result is modified.
Absent-by-design and not-applicable are structural statements, not failed Pressure recovery.
Liar’s Dice Family B remains partial for Pressure discriminant recovery; this benchmark does not relabel it as fully recovered.
This benchmark does not alter PCC Poker v0.8.0 or its human-data measurement contract.
